text: I think the biggest advantage is that students can learn a new language and meet people from different countries. They also become more independent because they have to live alone. For example, my cousin studied in Germany, and now he is much more confident. But it can be expensive, so not everyone can do it. Still, I'd say it's worth it.

tips.en: A real example from a relative's life makes the answer lively and convincing.
tips.kk: Туысының өмірінен алынған мысал жауапты тірі әрі сенімді етеді.
tips.ru: Пример из жизни родственника делает ответ живым и убедительным.
tips.example: For example, my cousin studied in Germany

tips.en: A short 'But' adds a drawback and shows balance.
tips.kk: Қысқа «But» кемшілікті қосып, пікір теңгерімін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Короткое «But» добавляет минус и показывает баланс мнений.
tips.example: But it can be expensive, so not everyone can do it

note.en: to learn to manage on your own
a natural way to give a final verdict
note.ru: Я бы сказал, оно того стоит

questions.question: What are the advantages of studying abroad?

text: In my opinion, yes, but only for older students. Young children don't really know what they like, so teachers should help them. But when students are sixteen or seventeen, they usually have an idea about their future job. If they study subjects they enjoy, they will work harder and get better marks. I think a mix of both is the best idea.

tips.en: A first conditional shows a result and raises Grammatical Range.
tips.kk: Бірінші типті шартты сөйлем нәтижені көрсетіп, Grammatical Range-ді арттырады.
tips.ru: Условное предложение первого типа показывает результат и повышает Grammatical Range.
tips.example: If they study subjects they enjoy, they will work harder and get better marks

tips.en: Separating by age shows a balanced position.
tips.kk: Жасқа қарай бөлу салмақты ұстанымды көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Разделение по возрасту показывает взвешенную позицию.
tips.example: But when students are sixteen or seventeen

questions.question: Should students be allowed to choose their own subjects at school?

text: Nowadays students can find information very quickly on the internet, so they don't always need a teacher. There are also many online courses, and some of them are free. This is great because people in small towns can study too. The problem is that some students just copy answers from the internet, and they don't really learn anything. So I think it depends on how you use it.

tips.en: 'The problem is that' moves smoothly from benefits to drawbacks.
tips.kk: «The problem is that» тіркесі артықшылықтардан кемшіліктерге жайлап өтуге көмектеседі.
tips.ru: Фраза «The problem is that» плавно переводит от плюсов к минусам.
tips.example: The problem is that some students just copy answers from the internet

tips.en: The conclusion 'it depends' sounds natural and avoids extremes.
tips.kk: «It depends» қорытындысы табиғи естіліп, шектен шығудан сақтайды.
tips.ru: Вывод «it depends» звучит естественно и избегает крайностей.
tips.example: it depends on how you use it

note.ru: это зависит от того, как использовать

phrases.text: it depends on how you use it

questions.followUp: Is it always a good change?
questions.question: How has technology changed the way students learn?

text: I don't think one is more important than the other. Teachers give children knowledge and show them how to study. But parents are the first people who teach children about life, like being polite and honest. For example, if parents read books at home, the child will probably like reading too. So I think both of them have to work together.

tips.en: Stating the opinion in the negative sounds mild and balanced.
tips.kk: Пікірді болымсыз түрде айту жұмсақ әрі салмақты естіледі.
tips.ru: Отрицательная формулировка мнения звучит мягко и взвешенно.
tips.example: I don't think one is more important than the other

tips.en: An everyday example with a conditional supports the idea.
tips.kk: Шартты сөйлеммен берілген тұрмыстық мысал ойды растайды.
tips.ru: Бытовой пример с условным предложением подтверждает мысль.
tips.example: For example, if parents read books at home, the child will probably like reading too

note.en: a relative clause giving a reason

phrases.text: the first people who teach children
